item.title: Verify the staged A2, M4f, N4 seed, M9c, and T2 work
item.prompt: Reconcile the current staged work for A2, M4f, N4 seed, M9c, and T2 against docs/WORK_PLAN.md section 3 and their relevant contracts. Preserve all unrelated changes. Repair only defects in those packages. Use focused checks while working; the queue runner will run the full external gates after your turn. Do not claim the integrated suite passed unless you actually ran it successfully. Do not commit, deploy, provision AWS resources, reset the tree, or change global agent settings. If Docker or another required capability is unavailable, report blocked with the exact failing command and reason. Keep the final result concise.
